notes.subject: fix(openai-compatible): request usage in streamed chat responses
notes.summary: OpenAI-compatible streamed chat requests now ask for usage data, so servers like Meridian report accurate token and cache counts; stream_options is also reserved against body mapping collisions.

notes.subject: fix(codex): use full Responses for GPT-6.x OAuth models
notes.summary: GPT-6.x Astra and Sol models over ChatGPT sign-in now use full Responses instead of Responses Lite, so they can make multiple parallel tool calls in one reply.
